dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, gradual linear narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None; lateral margins are smooth and exhibit a continuous, symmetrical curvilinear profile.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; uniform high-intensity pixel reflectance across the visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of thin, faint linear scratches (low-contrast rake marks) on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear markings/scratches visible on the posterior portion of the body.
